title: Ordinary derived scalar associators and point sections-tensor tower coherence
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$, and finite extensions $E\subset L\subset M$ of $\Ql$ in $\Qlb$ with valuation rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,s}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use ordinary K-flat derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on sheaf-module derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\theta^D$ be the natural sections-tensor comparison of [lem-weil-point-derived-sections-tensor-descent]. For $K\in D(R_E)$ put $A=K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L$, let $\alpha:(K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L)\otimes^L_{R_L}R_M\xrightarrow{\sim}K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_M$ be the canonical ordinary derived scalar associator, and let $a^{\mathrm{mod}}$ be the module-complex associator. Then
$$\Gamma(s,\alpha)\circ\theta^D_{M/L,A}\circ(\theta^D_{L/E,K}\otimes1)=\theta^D_{M/E,K}\circ a^{\mathrm{mod}}.$$

This equation holds on cochain representatives and in derived categories, naturally for all derived morphisms. On a K-flat flat-term representative $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], $P\otimes_{R_E}R_L$ is K-flat with flat terms and represents $A$; $\alpha$ and its inverse are represented by the balanced sheaf maps $((x\otimes a)\otimes b)\mapsto x\otimes ab$ and $x\otimes b\mapsto(x\otimes1)\otimes b$. The common sections map in the displayed equation sends $((n\otimes a)\otimes b)$ to the section $n\otimes ab$. The associator is natural also on arbitrary derived roofs. For $L=E$, the multiplication maps $x\otimes r\mapsto rx$ on sheaf complexes and $n\otimes r\mapsto rn$ on module complexes intertwine $\theta^D_{E/E,K}$. For four finite fields $E\subset L\subset M\subset H$, the two iterated ordinary scalar associators agree, and every iterated sections comparison is compatible with them: the resulting map on a representative sends $(((n\otimes a)\otimes b)\otimes c)$ to $n\otimes abc$. These unit and iterated equations are independent of all chosen resolutions. These assertions concern ordinary derived tensors, with no completion comparison or integral scalar-extension functor in the conclusion.
